COOLING_DEGRADATION: summer (Jun-Sep) minus shoulder (Mar-May, Oct-Nov) mean of 1-HRI >= 1.5 pts, above peer p75 (class x climate region x EIA-860 cooling type x year, fallback class x year), >=2 consecutive years or positive trend over >=3 years, summer fouling/duct-firing share <50%; overrides unattributed/non-recoverable/HGP/cycling/healthy summer deficit months

BOP_INTERMITTENT: plant-year with heavy cycling/trip exposure (CEMS starts/MW/yr or trip rate > class p75; proxy LF CV > p75), no wash or sawtooth, >=3 deficit months, CV of monthly deficit >=0.5, not summer-seasonal (summer/annual mean <=1.3)
Recovery fractions COOLING_DEGRADATION 0.75, BOP_INTERMITTENT 0.60; remediation costs placeholders

BPRI weights 0.30/0.25/0.15/0.10/0.05/0.10/0.05; percentiles within class x size band x climate region (>=5 peers, else class x size band, else class); missing CEMS components renormalised with bpri_confidence=low; C1 absent for GT/IC (no condenser) renormalised; evidence missing for lack of monthly data imputed at p50 and flagged

Tiers: CONFIRMED C1>=p75 & C2>=p75 & persistent >=2 yrs (cooling flag years or C2>=p75 years); LIKELY C1 or C2 >=p75 & exposure >=p60; EXPOSED exposure >=p80 & no evidence. Yearly tiers use that year C1/C2 with static exposure

CEMS: EPA CAMPD hourly state files 2024-2025; start = off->on sustained >=2 h above 5% of unit max; trip = >40% of max to 0 in one hour; cold/warm/hot >48/8-48/<8 h offline; units mapped to class by EPA unit type. Validated: median CEMS/EIA-923 heat input 1.00
BoP age = 2025 minus earliest generator operating year at the plant x class (original COD, not latest uprate)
Month-over-month HR noise gate: raw HR % change on CC monthly respondents, non-CHP, LF>=0.6 both months, |dLF|<=0.10
Recoverable $ for targeting = cooling + BoP-intermittent recoverable in the last 24 months / 2
